scope_note: The sources identify CNF satisfiability in a subspace with union-of-subspaces avoidance and provide finite-field subspace-arrangement context. The laminar polynomial theorem and proof-carrying implementation are established in the C041 proof note; no claim of literature novelty is made.

sources.role: Primary equivalence between SUB-SAT, union-of-subspace avoidance, and products of affine forms; also supplies hardness context for unrestricted instances.
sources.title: CNF Satisfiability in a Subspace and Related Problems

sources.role: Primary finite-field subspace-arrangement counting context via intersection data and characteristic polynomials.
sources.title: Subspace Arrangements over Finite Fields: Cohomological and Enumerative Properties
